CENTURION_SCROLL.name: Centurion Scroll

GUILD_SAPPHIRE.name: Guild Sapphire

IMMERSION_ASTROLABE.name: Immersion Astrolabe

IMMERSION_ASTROLABE.essentialLore: Cabinet piece awarded for surpassing 100 productive focus hours.

ALCHEMIST_SCALE.essentialLore: Badge for maintaining sustainable balance across 100 redeemed rewards.

GRANDMASTER_CODEX.name: Grandmaster Codex

sourcesGuide.title: XP Sources (never spent in the Store)
sourcesGuide.tooltipTitle: How do you climb the pyramid?
sourcesGuide.tooltipAria: Learn how to earn XP and advance your rank
sourcesGuide.tooltipIntro: Unlike coins (🪙), XP is lifetime-cumulative and is never deducted when redeeming rewards in the Store:
sourcesGuide.tasksDesc: From +2 XP (Trivial) up to +30 XP (Hard) at 100% base value when completed on time.
sourcesGuide.dailiesDesc: 100% difficulty XP on scheduled days + a +10% consistency bonus after 14 consecutive completions.
sourcesGuide.habitsDesc: From +5 XP (Low) up to +25 XP (High) to reinforce daily momentum.
sourcesGuide.focusDesc: Standard Pomodoro (+8 XP/cycle), Deep Work 50m+ (+15 XP/cycle), and Free Stopwatch (+7 XP per 30m).
sourcesGuide.noSpendNote: 💡 Only Hardcore penalties (or negative habits within a tier) affect XP, and a floor lock prevents demoting below your current rank.
sourcesGuide.titleEssential: Point Sources (never spent in the Showcase)
sourcesGuide.tooltipAriaEssential: Learn how to earn points and advance your executive rank
sourcesGuide.tooltipIntroEssential: Unlike Credits, Points are lifetime-cumulative and are never deducted when redeeming rewards in the Showcase:
sourcesGuide.tasksDescEssential: From +2 pts (Trivial) up to +30 pts (Hard) at 100% base value when completed on time.
sourcesGuide.dailiesDescEssential: 100% base effort points on scheduled days + a +10% consistency bonus after 14 consecutive completions.
sourcesGuide.habitsDescEssential: From +5 pts (Low) up to +25 pts (High) to reinforce daily momentum.
sourcesGuide.focusDescEssential: Standard Pomodoro (+8 pts/cycle), Deep Work 50m+ (+15 pts/cycle), and Free Stopwatch (+7 pts per 30m).
sourcesGuide.noSpendNoteEssential: 💡 Only Strict Deadline penalties (or negative habits within a tier) affect points, and a floor lock prevents demoting below your current rank.
